the systemic effects of ablation therapy can be modulated by the energy source used and the tumor microenvironment, and that these factors should be considered when choosing the appropriate ablation technique for a specific clinical scenario.
IRE is not a "better" ablation modality than radiofrequency ablation (RFA) but that the choice of energy source should be tailored to the specific clinical scenario.

the systemic effects of ablation may not always be as detrimental to the patient as once believed.
the systemic effects of ablation are not trivial and should be taken into account when planning and performing ablative procedures.
